observational_status: matched four-case 25-frame normalized-native M3D-C1 source-response diagnostic at dt=0.00125; not an imported experimental shot, validated shot-to-native handoff, physical current quadrature or segmented-electrode controller-in-loop test
successful_milestone: Four matched native M3D-C1 runs at dt=0.00125 completed with exact zero-source field equivalence (0 <= 1e-12) and 1004-element mesh. At t=0.03, e[2]-weighted cancellation is 80.24% negative / 79.71% positive, with opposite signed jphi responses; R*e[2]-weighted cancellation is 79.57% negative / 79.04% positive. This supports qualitative redistribution-like numerical response but not convergence or physical current conservation.
interpretation: Odd-symmetry residual at t=0.03 fell from 35.94% (dt=0.0025) to 3.11% (dt=0.00125), but cancellation shifted +6.71 and +3.92 percentage points, respectively, and four-level signed-proxy/cancellation differences are nonmonotone. Convergence remains unvalidated; an apparently improved symmetry at a single time is not proof. Follow-up compares full jphi response fields at matched times instead of another unqualified timestep halving.
followup_scope: One focused eight-run two-resolution (dt=0.0025 and 0.00125) fieldwise jphi response comparison with matched mesh, source and gate, L2/Linf difference, spatial correlation, zero-equivalence and odd-symmetry diagnostics at t=0.01,0.02,0.03. No solver physics or frozen thresholds altered.
handoff_equivalence: unvalidated; exact same-mode zero-source equivalence is not experimental shot-to-native equilibrium/profile handoff
